title: UDCDGA_Generator: A reproducible and extensible framework for constructing DGA datasets
description:
UDCDGA_Generator is an open-source Python framework for the reproducible construction of datasets for Domain Generation Algorithm (DGA) research. The software implements a modular three-stage workflow comprising benign-source aggregation, DGA-generated domain generation, and balanced dataset construction with feature extraction.

The framework supports configurable and deterministic dataset generation, domain normalization and validation, duplicate and cross-class overlap removal, persistent deduplication, execution statistics, integrity validation, and reproducibility metadata. The default feature registry contains 54 lexical, structural, statistical, and n-gram-based numerical features, while experiment-specific feature configurations can be defined through an extensible feature registry. The resulting datasets are exported primarily in Apache Parquet format together with metadata and integrity artifacts.

UDCDGA_Generator is designed to facilitate the construction, extension, and regeneration of DGA datasets for cybersecurity research, including machine-learning-based DGA detection, feature analysis, and explainable artificial intelligence studies.

Version 1.0.1 is a maintenance release incorporating corrections and validation improvements introduced during the SoftwareX review process.
